text: Paper and book atlas / 2006 How Long Can Tiny H I Clouds Survive? Nagashima, Inutsuka & Koyama · 2006 ApJ Letters 652, L41–L44 Reference listed · scope proposed Spherical cloud evaporation times depend on cloud size and ambient pressure, with a quasi-steady interpretation. Scope in this archive. Candidate: reproduce the analytic timescale/critical-radius relation and, if practical, a one-dimensional radial benchmark. Large multidimensional reruns are unnecessary for this scope. Source review: Bibliography and abstract checked; equations and target figures require a dedicated audit.
